notes.title: v0.42.1 - Introducing Animations!
notes.content:
Hey,

as many already know I have been working on an animation feature for GRAB for over a year and while it may still not be perfect yet, I am confident that they are now good enough for everyone to start using!
I believe that animations will enable a lot of new gameplay and more immersive levels due to animated details that can be all around you.
This is just the beginning and I already have a lot more improvements planned around animations.

[previewyoutube=Upbt-eHZ2gE;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]What are Animations?[/b]

Animations allow objects in your levels to move around between fixed positions and rotations that you can specify when building your level. This allows for moving platforms, boulders to run from, roller coasters, moving creatures and so much more.

[b]How to Animate?[/b]

Select the object or group of objects you want to animate, select the “Selection” tab where you usually change a blocks color or group them together and in the top right corner select “Animate”.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42602473/d39fe7c721518b3608472b6033d9b9a54b5c4d7c.png[/img]

Animations are made from frames, each frame represents the objects position and rotation at a specific point in time. To create a frame, just move the object to the desired position and press the “Add Frame” button.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42602473/e1161172cf1e1fbe039ff1b6fd83a77cb4010a38.png[/img]

For now, whenever an animation reaches the last frame the animation will immediately restart.

Animations do not cost complexity and every object in a level can be animated with up to 500 frames per animation.

[b]If you encounter any issues, please join my discord server to report them: [url=https://discord.gg/jScgbSF]https://discord.gg/jScgbSF[/url][/b]

I can't wait to see what you will build!

Nils

- I am still working on the feature that shall not be named... I made some good progress recently, but it's still far from ready unfortunately. Until then other updates will probably keep being slow :(

notes.title: v0.30.2 - New Cosmetics
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] New cosmetics pack!
[*] Made the speaker symbol on the player list more in sync with what you hear to more easily determine who to report, mute or kick.
[*] Editor music is now preloaded on startup to prevent stuttering when opening the editor.
[*] Made menu and editor music toggles work independently.
[*] Hopefully fixed some crashes.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.30.0 - New lobby and more colors
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]New lobby!
[*]Added support for arbitrary colors for color blocks through hex color codes.
[*]Added limits for arm length and player height.
[*]Changed the curve for hand velocity, making glitch jumping less effective and generally making extremely high jumps harder.
[*]Temporarily disabled bhaptics support. The latest quest update requires me to make some bigger changes to make it work again.
[*]Some minor crash fixes.
[/list]
